description: Fetch a Mintive documentation page from a public docs URL or a slug, for example "https://www.mintmcp.com/docs/security/tool-governance" or just "security/tool-governance". Use it when a user pastes a docs link or names a page directly. It returns the same full markdown content as fetch.

url.description: A docs page URL or slug, e.g. "https://www.mintmcp.com/docs/enterprise/sso" or "enterprise/sso".

name: get_page
title: Get a Mintive docs page
